sqlReaderQuery.value:
SELECT
    j.job_id,
    j.job_name,
    j.load_type,
    MAX(CASE WHEN d.dtls_key = 'source_schema' THEN d.dtls_value END) AS source_schema,
    MAX(CASE WHEN d.dtls_key = 'source_table' THEN d.dtls_value END) AS source_table,
    MAX(CASE WHEN d.dtls_key = 'watermark_column' THEN d.dtls_value END) AS watermark_column,
    MAX(CASE WHEN d.dtls_key = 'primary_key_column' THEN d.dtls_value END) AS primary_key_column,
    MAX(CASE WHEN d.dtls_key = 'target_container' THEN d.dtls_value END) AS target_container,
    MAX(CASE WHEN d.dtls_key = 'target_path' THEN d.dtls_value END) AS target_path,
    MAX(CASE WHEN d.dtls_key = 'file_format' THEN d.dtls_value END) AS file_format
FROM dbo.vb_tbl_job j
INNER JOIN dbo.vb_tbl_job_dtls d
    ON j.job_id = d.job_id
WHERE j.job_id = 14
  AND j.active_flag = 1
GROUP BY
    j.job_id,
    j.job_name,
    j.load_type;

SELECT
    TABLE_SCHEMA AS source_schema,
    TABLE_NAME AS source_table,
    'ModifiedDate' AS watermark_column,
    'INCREMENTAL' AS load_type
FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES
WHERE TABLE_TYPE = 'BASE TABLE'
  AND TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo'
  AND TABLE_NAME IN
  (
      'Customers',
      'Payments',
      'Products',
      'SalesOrderItems',
      'SalesOrders',
      'Stores'
  )
ORDER BY TABLE_NAME;

SELECT
    watermark_column,
    last_watermark_value
FROM dbo.vb_tbl_watermark
WHERE job_id = @{pipeline().parameters.p_job_id}
  AND source_schema = '@{item().source_schema}'
  AND source_table = '@{item().source_table}';

@concat(
    'SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), MAX(',
    item().watermark_column,
    '), 121) AS current_watermark FROM ',
    item().source_schema,
    '.',
    item().source_table
)

@concat(
    'SELECT * FROM ',
    item().source_schema,
    '.',
    item().source_table,
    ' WHERE ',
    item().watermark_column,
    ' > ''',
    activity('Lookup_Table_Watermark').output.firstRow.last_watermark_value,
    ''' AND ',
    item().watermark_column,
    ' <= ''',
    activity('Lookup_Current_Table_Watermark').output.firstRow.current_watermark,
    ''''
)
